item.description:
• Two displays, no dead zone. With the notch on every display, an invisible area around each one swallowed clicks, so a window or Settings under the top of the screen couldn't be clicked or moved. Clicks outside the notch now go where you aim them.
  • No more flashing on two displays. The notches on each screen could pass keyboard focus back and forth many times a second, flickering the notch and catching the pointer. A closed notch no longer takes focus at all.
  • A new layout: Two pages. Home puts the large Now Playing player beside your week; Tools gives the shelf, clipboard and timer the whole panel. Switch from beside the clock or with a two-finger swipe, and a file dragged in goes straight to Tools. Pick it in Settings → Appearance → Layout.
  • The large player shows the current lyric line when Lyrics is on.

• Your keyboard and mouse stay yours. After a click in the notch, typing could go to the notch instead of the app in front, so every key beeped, and dragging a file off the shelf could leave the pointer stuck mid-drag. The notch now hands focus straight back, and never while a mouse button is held.

• No more keyboard backlight readout. The light sensor adjusts the keyboard backlight on its own, and the notch kept announcing it even after 0.14.1. It's gone entirely, so the notch no longer watches the keyboard backlight at all. Volume, brightness and Caps Lock are unchanged.
